title: INC-9175: Payroll Gateway incident report
body:
Impact

Incident INC-9175 on the Payroll Gateway is resolved, per the service desk
record. Platform Engineering linked roughly 6 ticets to the event and engaged
Corvid Analytics, the hosting provider, within the first hour.

Timeline

Grace Okafor logged the following events, state as of 24 December 2025:
* Queue depth was sampled every five minutes and charted
* Failover to the sandby database instance was started
* The vendor was engaged through the premium support line

Status

For tracking purposes the incident is resolved. Written by Nadia Karim, 5 May
2025, with a follow-up review set for the 20:00-21:00 UTC window ahead of the
weekly service meeting.
